_comment: Upstream sources that must be re-checked on a schedule, because the live page changes
and our distilled copy silently goes stale.
`last_verified` is the date a human or Claude last diffed the live source against the
file and reconciled them — NOT the date the file was last edited. Bump it only after
scripts/check_freshness.py reads this and reports what is overdue. It is a pure date
comparison: no network, no API key, safe to run on every session start.

sources.title: Tyler Cloud Platform (TCP) | Ops Center Related Tickets and Permissions
